blocks.text: ✅ Exterior Painting Prep Checklist (What We Do Before We Paint)

At Black Pearl Painters, we’re proud to provide expert exterior painting services for single-family homes, townhomes, condos, and commercial properties throughout Tacoma, Gig Harbor, Puyallup, Bonney Lake, and nearby communities. Whether you own a craftsman-style house in North Tacoma, manage a condo complex in South Hill, or run a business storefront in downtown Puyallup, we bring the same high level of care and attention to every project.

Before we begin painting, we follow a meticulous painting prep guide that ensures your exterior will look flawless and hold up against our Northwest weather. Here’s a breakdown of what our professional painters handle for every job, big or small:
☐ Inspect siding, trim, and surfaces for damage

We begin by inspecting your building’s exterior for any damage. From wood rot and cracked trim to warped siding or loose nails, our team identifies and fixes these issues before painting. It’s part of our commitment to quality no shortcuts, no surprises.
☐ Power wash to remove dirt and mildew

Using professional-grade power washing equipment, we clear away years of dirt, mildew, and buildup. This critical first step creates a clean surface for paint to properly adhere, whether it’s a classic home in Gig Harbor or a brick retail space in Tacoma.
☐ Scrape off peeling or flaking paint
We carefully scrape away any loose, peeling, or blistering paint from wood, stucco, or other siding materials. Proper surface prep prevents future peeling and ensures an even, beautiful finish.
☐ Repair cracks, holes, and caulk gaps

Our experienced team will patch damaged areas, seal cracks, and re-caulk around trim, windows, and doors. These small fixes make a big difference, especially in condo communities and commercial buildings, where long-term durability and appearance matter most.
☐ Sand rough or glossy surfaces

Sanding smooths out rough edges and dulls glossy areas, allowing fresh paint to bond properly. This step is especially important on entryways, signage, and high-traffic areas in businesses and townhomes.
☐ Prime bare wood or patched areas

We spot-prime bare wood and repaired sections using high-performance primer designed to seal and protect. Our approach ensures a seamless, long-lasting finish especially critical for homes and buildings exposed to moisture in places like Bonney Lake and Steilacoom.
☐ Choose high-quality exterior paint

We proudly use premium paints from Sherwin-Williams, chosen for their outstanding durability, fade resistance, and rich color selection. Whether we’re refreshing the look of a cozy home or giving a multi-unit property or business exterior a bold new look, our expert guidance helps you choose the right paint for performance and curb appeal.
☐ Protect landscaping and hardscapes

From commercial landscaping and sidewalks to family flower beds and backyard decks, we carefully cover and protect everything around your property before we start. Our clean, efficient prep process ensures nothing is damaged or disrupted.
